name: Oshiete Miko Sensei Ni
source:
Main character is dragged into the "Shrine Maiden Promotion Committee" aiming at reconstruction of a devastated shrine. One day two shrine maidens - mother and daughter - come to the committee as advisors and start to live with the protagonist.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被硬拉进旨在重建荒废神社的“巫女推广委员会”。
某天，两名巫女——一对母女——以顾问身份来到委员会，并开始与主角同住。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-october-2007-boku-ga-sadame.html]vndbreview[/url]]
